en.headline: Government gazettes Education Amendment Bill requiring teacher practising certificates
en.dek: The bill, published on Friday, requires all teachers including principals to hold registration and a practising certificate valid for no more than three school years, and bars those convicted of national security…
body: The Government gazetted the Education (Amendment) Bill 2026 on Friday. The measure introduces a practising certificate requirement in addition to existing teacher registration, applying to teachers and principals in publicly-funded schools, private schools, international schools and kindergartens.

A spokesman for the Education Bureau said the certificate would be valid for no more than three school years and that applicants must meet continuing professional development requirements. The bill also establishes safeguards to prevent persons convicted of offences endangering national security from teaching, to protect students and uphold professional standards.

The Education Bureau has consulted the sector since September 2025 and the Legislative Council Panel on Education in February. The bill is scheduled for first and second reading in the Legislative Council on 25 November.

zh.headline: 政府刊憲《2026年教育修訂條例草案》引入教師執業證明書
zh.dek: 草案周五刊憲，規定所有學校教師包括校長須持有教師註冊及執業證明書，有效期不超逾三個學年，並設機制防止干犯國安罪行者任教。
body: 政府周五在憲報刊登《2026年教育（修訂）條例草案》，引入教師執業證明書要求，完善教師註冊機制。草案規定所有公帑資助學校、私立學校、國際學校及幼稚園的教師（包括校長）必須持有教師註冊及執業證明書，方可任教。
教育局發言人表示，執業證明書有效期不超逾三個學年，申請條件包括須符合持續專業發展要求。草案亦設立防護機制，防止被裁定干犯危害國家安全罪行的人士在學校任教，以保障學生及維護教師專業操守。
教育局自2025年9月起諮詢業界，並於今年2月諮詢立法會教育事務委員會，持份者普遍支持。草案將於11月25日提交立法會首讀及二讀。
